Behandlingen utförs i enlighet med tjäns: The Treatment is performed in accordance with the service specification, the individual treatment plan and the offer which the Client has received and accepted before entering into the Agreement. The treatment plan and offer set out, among other things, the choice of injection type, treatment area, number of treatments and price.
Kunden bekräftar att denne, före Avtalet: The Client confirms that, before entering into the Agreement and before the Treatment is performed, the Client has received clear and complete information about the Treatment, including its main content, performance, expected results, risks, aftercare and price, as well as about relevant alternative treatment options, and that the Client has had the opportunity to ask questions and receive satisfactory answers. The information has been provided both orally at the consultation and in writing through the service specification, the offer and the individual treatment plan.
Tjänstespecifikation, offert och individ: The service specification, the offer and the individual treatment plan form part of the agreement documentation but are not attached to this Agreement.
Pris för Behandlingen framgår av den off: The price for the Treatment is set out in the offer which the Client received in writing before, or in connection with, entering into the Agreement. The Client confirms that the offer has been reviewed and discussed with the Client at the consultation and accepted before or in connection with the signing of this Agreement. The offer forms part of the agreement documentation but is not attached to this Agreement.
Tjänsteutövaren tillämpar betänketid (Be: The Provider applies a cooling-off period. The Agreement can only become binding once at least two (2) days have passed from the Client receiving information about the Treatment in the service description.
Avtalet är giltigt från att Kunden under: The Agreement is valid from the Client signing the Agreement after the cooling-off period has ended until the Treatment has been completed by the Provider. Should the Client not book a treatment time, or after cancellation not book a new time, the Agreement ceases to apply 30 days after being signed by the Client.
Behandlingen är en privat tjänst som bek: The Treatment is a private service paid for by the Client.
Betalning ska erläggas via faktura, kort: Payment shall be made by invoice, card payment, Swish, bank transfer, cash payment or financing through Medical Finance and must be received by the Provider before the Treatment begins. The Provider reserves the right to cancel the treatment time and terminate the Agreement with immediate effect if full payment has not been made in time.
Kundens av-/ombokning av behandlingstid: The Client's cancellation/rebooking of the treatment time must be made at the latest 2 calendar days before the planned treatment day. This gives the Provider the opportunity to adjust the schedule and offer the time to another client if needed. For rebooking, the Client must contact contact@hairtpclinic.com. The cancellation/rebooking is valid only once the Client has received written confirmation of the rebooking from the Provider. If the Client has not received such confirmation within 48 hours, the Client must contact the Provider.
Vid Kundens av-/ombokning mindre än 2 da: In the event of the Client's cancellation/rebooking less than 2 days before the treatment date, the Provider reserves the right to charge an administrative fee of SEK 500. In case of illness, the treatment time is rescheduled free of charge, provided that the Client can present a medical certificate certifying that the Client should not undergo the treatment.
Kunden är införstådd med att risker före: The Client understands that the risks associated with the Treatment and its expected results depend on personal and medical conditions as well as compliance with all preparation and aftercare instructions. The Provider uses its skill and experience to achieve the best possible result based on the Client's individual conditions but cannot guarantee a specific result.
Kunden är införstådd med att Kunden har: The Client understands that the Client is personally responsible for not using tobacco or nicotine products before or after the treatment and for following all preparation and aftercare instructions.
Tjänsteutövaren ansvarar endast för dire: The Provider is only liable for direct damage caused by the company's negligence. Beyond that, the Provider bears no liability with regard to the Treatment, such as for complications, loss of income or an unwanted result. The Provider is also not liable for, for example, incorrectly manufactured medical products.
Behandlingen omfattas av lag (2005:59) o: The Treatment is covered by the Act (2005:59) on distance contracts and contracts outside business premises (the Distance Contracts Act). The patient has the right to withdraw from the Agreement within 14 days from the date the Agreement is entered into. To exercise the right of withdrawal, the patient must send a clear and unequivocal message to the Provider stating that the patient wishes to exercise their right of withdrawal. Such a message can be sent to contact@hairtpclinic.com.
För det fall att Kunden önskar påbörja B: In the event that the Client wishes to start the Treatment and book a treatment time that falls before the end of the Client's withdrawal period, the Client's special consent is required.
Avtalsbrott och force majeure: Breach of contract and force majeure

Tjänstutövaren ska även äga rätt att säg: The Provider shall also have the right to terminate the Agreement with immediate effect in the event of the Client's material breach of contract or repeated breaches of contract.

Kunden lämnar härmed sitt informerade sa: The Client hereby gives their informed consent for the Treatment to be performed.
Swedish law shall apply to the Agreement.
För det fall utförd behandling omfattas: If the performed treatment is covered by the Provider's patient insurance under the Patient Injury Act (1996:799), the Client may refer any dispute to the Patient Injury Committee. Regarding matters that do not require medical expertise, the Client also has the option to refer a dispute to review through a complaint to the General Complaints Board (ARN). A dispute arising from the Agreement shall ultimately be decided by a general court with the Gothenburg District Court as the first instance.
